howToBook.q: How do I book a flight or rent a car from Masar?
howToBook.a: From the home page, choose the section that suits you—accommodations, car rentals, or travel services—and you'll find all the offers ready for direct booking with just one click.

aiTripPlanner.q: What are the benefits of AI-powered smart planning?
aiTripPlanner.a: Masar suggests a complete trip package (hotel + car + itinerary) tailored to your schedule and budget, so you don't have to spend time searching and comparing dozens of websites on your own.

airportPickup.q: Do you offer a pickup service from Cairo Airport?
airportPickup.a: Yes, a private driver will pick you up right at the arrivals gate and take you to your hotel or any other location you specify—booking and payment must be made before you travel.

carClasses.q: Are there different categories of cars to choose from?
carClasses.a: From economy cars for getting around town, to family cars that seat 7 passengers, to luxury cars like Mercedes and BMW—all come with comprehensive insurance.

hireDriver.q: Can I hire a private driver by the day or by the week?
hireDriver.a: Yes, you can book a private driver for a day or a full week, depending on your itinerary, with the flexibility to change your destination or schedule.

englishDrivers.q: Do the drivers speak English and organize daily tours?
englishDrivers.a: Yes, our drivers are trained to work with foreign visitors, and we can arrange a full-day tour for you to any tourist destination you choose.

flightTickets.q: Do you book domestic and international flights?
flightTickets.a: Yes, you can book airline tickets for domestic and international flights on the same platform, at competitive prices and without having to go to another website.

northCoastTrips.q: Can I book a trip from Cairo to the North Coast?
northCoastTrips.a: Yes, you can book a car or a private driver for the trip from Cairo to the North Coast, with suggested rest stops along the way.

trustScore.q: How can I make sure the car is in good condition before I pick it up?
trustScore.a: Each car has a Trust Score based on an analysis of actual photos of its condition, so you can see a clear rating before confirming your reservation.

arabicSupport.q: Is there Arabic-language support for visitors to the Gulf?
arabicSupport.a: Yes, the support team and drivers speak Arabic fluently, and all booking and payment details are available in your language from the very beginning.

TestimonialsSection.title: A journey our customers trust
TestimonialsSection.footerNote: Real reviews from our customers on Google — names are listed as they appeared, with only minor spelling corrections made where necessary.

sara.name: Sarah Mahmoud
sara.text: I booked a car with a driver for a full week, and the service was excellent from the very beginning. The driver was professional and spoke English well, and he recommended some amazing places we hadn’t known about.

ahmed.name: Ahmed Reda
ahmed.text: I used the airport pickup service from Cairo Airport, and the driver was waiting for me right on time. The entire booking and payment process was very easy on the website.

layla.name: Laila Hassan
layla.text: Great service. I used the smart planning feature, and it suggested a complete trip (hotel and car) in just a few minutes. It saved me a lot of time compared to doing the research myself.

khalid.name: Khalid Al-Otaibi
khalid.text: One of the best companies I've dealt with in Egypt. The hotel I booked was exactly as described, and the support in Arabic made everything easier.

andrew.name: Andrew Alexan
andrew.text: Excellent service—the cars arrived on time, and they have a good selection at reasonable prices. I recommend them to anyone looking for an organized trip in Egypt.
